user_saw: A subagent's completion row in the chat transcript showed a generic robot icon instead of the colored avatar its launch row used.
summary: Named subagent completion rows now render the session-keyed SubagentName avatar/name and drop the generic bot icon, keeping it only for anonymous completions.
reasoning: The completion component was created in 18136c960eaf (#198133) deliberately rendering `<Icon name="bot" />` and the plain label; nothing broke or misbehaved, and the fix is a visual-consistency polish of that design rather than a repair of a failure.
